sources.title: The Annals of the World, Deduced from the Origin of Time (1658 English edition), Part One: 4004–176 BC
sources.license_note: Internet Archive item marked Public Domain Mark 1.0.
sources.note: Scan of the 1658 London edition (E. Tyler for J. Crook & G. Bedell). OCR is poor in the margins; dates were read from the modern transcription (ussher-annals-transcription) and spot-checked against this scan.

sources.title: The Annals of the World (modern-spelling transcription of the 1658 edition)
sources.license_note: File states: "This work is in the Public Domain. Copy Freely." Provenance of the modernised text is not independently confirmed.
sources.note: Paragraph numbers (e.g. §22) refer to this transcription. Known typo: Mahalaleel's lifespan printed as 892 (Gen 5:17 = 895; Ussher's own AM 1290 death date implies 895).

sources.title: The history of the world (London: printed [by William Stansby] for Walter Burre, 1617), EEBO-TCP A10357
sources.translator_or_editor: Text Creation Partnership (EEBO-TCP Phase I transcription); EarlyPrint Project (linguistic tagging)
sources.license_note: EEBO-TCP Phase I keyboarded/encoded text released under CC0 1.0 (stated in the TEI <availability> of the EarlyPrint and TCP files); underlying 1617 work public domain by age. Page images not covered. OTA item page unreachable (504) on 2026-10-17, so its licence statement was not re-checked.
sources.note: Primary text for the Raleigh chronology. Local copies and SHA-256 checksums in sources/raleigh/ (README.md); the two ~86 MB EarlyPrint XML files are gitignored and restored by scripts/fetch-raleigh.sh.

sources.title: The History of the World, in Five Books (11th ed.), vol. 1

sources.note: Secondary reading copy (11th ed., Internet Archive OCR). The 1617 EEBO-TCP text (raleigh-history-of-the-world-1617) is the primary text; existing Raleigh anchors still cite this 1736 edition pending re-extraction.
